import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace spaces and non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, then collapse consecutive hyphens
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)
    return text.strip('-')


def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
